spans.s: (I)--the son of Jaya (सञ्जय-वि। प्।). and father of Yugandhara. भा. IX. २४. १४; Vi. IV. १४. 3.
--a powerful ally of जरासन्ध; placed at the north gate of मथुरा during its siege, and of Gomanta during its siege: see कुलिन्द। Bha. X. ५०. ११ (7); ५२. ११ (१४).
--a son of वेदशिरस्; an अवतार् of the १५थ् द्वापर। (See also कुनी). वा. २३. १६९.

--Five in प्रयाग, in the midst of which flows the गङ्गा;
1: M. १०४. १३.
three fire कुण्डस् outside प्रयाग through which the Ganges flows.
2: M. ११०. 4.
(II)--the son of क्षुद्रक and father of Suratha. Vi. IV. २२. 9.
(III)--one of the eleven वसिष्ठ branches. वा. ७०. ९०.

(IV)--the capital of Vidarbhas; दमघोष arrived at; बलराम's arrival; Rukmi's resolve not to enter the capital without vanquishing कृष्ण.
1: भा. X. ५३. 7. १५ and २१; ५४. १९-20, ५२; Vi. V. २६. 1.
Here शाल्व had a conference of princes to get rid of कृष्ण.
2: भा. X. ७६. 2 [8-9].
